name: Kadrak's Flag
summary: At the Barrens border, Kadrak sends the Horde's colors into enemy ground. The banner is planted in the Talon Den after Rynthariel is killed.

sections.title: A Mark of Defiance
sections.body: Kadrak sends the Horde flag into the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak. Rynthariel, the Den's dryad Keymaster, has sent messages across the border. Kadrak decides her death alone will not answer them. He gives you a crimson banner to plant deep inside the Den. There, the Horde colors warn the night elves and dryads that incursions across the Barrens will meet retaliation on Alliance soil.

faq.q: What is Kadrak's Flag used for?
faq.answer: After killing Rynthariel the Keymaster, plant Kadrak's Flag inside the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak. The Horde banner warns the night elves against sending more scouts and messengers into the Barrens.
Kadrak gives you the banner. He is an orc scout at the border watchpost between the northern Barrens and Ashenvale, working to secure the region.
Plant the banner inside the Talon Den, a cavern sanctuary on the western slopes of Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Rynthariel is a dryad and Keymaster of the Talon Den. She sends messengers into Horde territory until Kadrak intercepts her communications and orders her killed.

angles.text: Planting the banner deep inside the Talon Den declares the Horde's strength. It shows the Horde will strike night elf sanctuaries when provoked.
As a night elf, you see the Horde banner inside the Talon Den as a direct insult to Stonetalon Peak's protectors.
